blurb: Guests wear a custom VR helmet and wingsuit to experience simulated BASE jumping and proximity flying in a controlled environment. The experience includes multiple jumps, avatar customization, pre-jump preparation, and a shareable video. It typically lasts 30 to 45 minutes with 10-12 minutes of flight time.
